title: 第17章 在找被你带回来的鬼吗第18章 答应鬼的要求
slug: 算命太准外国客户都哭着喊大佬
content_zh:
第17章在找被你带回来的鬼吗
室内门窗关着，没有风吹进来，而空调也一直打的是恒温不会轻易变动，所以陡然降低的温度，难道说真的是有什么东西被弄出来了。
想到这里，吴妈妈的脸色瞬间变了。
唯独周奶奶那个兴奋啊，这就是见鬼的感觉吗？虽然鬼有点吓人，可这不是有林熙在吗，那必须不怕啊！
周奶奶现在可是林熙的忠实粉丝了。
“大师，那东西被抓出来了吗？在哪呢？”
林熙也是没见过胆子这么大的老太太，第一次见鬼还如此兴奋。
不过老太太只是普通人，没有阴阳眼，且八字稳，不容易看到这些东西。
“就在距离你三步远的正北方向。”
林熙好心的给老太太提醒了一下那鬼的位置，又问她，“你想看吗，我可以…..”
帮你。
话还没说完，周奶奶便疯狂摆手。
“不用了不用了，我就是好奇而已，哈，哈哈。”
她胆子再大也不想见鬼啊。
林熙和周奶奶这边聊得你来我往的，旁边的鬼却快哭了。
他怎么也没有想到自己竟然会有看走眼的一天，直接栽在了一个小丫头片子手上。
此刻她单手轻轻的拎着自己，自己就跟个小鸡仔似的毫无反抗之力，而且他隐约能感受到一股强大的压制力。
可这丫头明明什么宝物和器具都没用，只有一双手啊，这是为啥？！
如果林熙知道这鬼心里在好奇什么的话，恐怕会告诉他，她虽然没有用宝器，但她灵魂对阴魂鬼怪等物的压制力很强。
也就是现在灵魂和肉身还没完全融合，不能发挥出她曾经的十分之一威力，但即使这样，靠灵魂的压制力也能让它们畏惧。

那鬼被林熙控制住了，沙发上的吴斌却忽然闭上了眼睛。
吴妈妈见状立刻大喊：“儿子？儿子你怎么了？！”
林熙看了他一眼：“没什么大碍，只是这段时间阴魂上身导致的疲惫体弱，之后晒几天太阳，或者是我给他一道安神符就好了。”
说着，林熙另一只手将定身符从吴斌头上取下，再将其折叠成三角形，口中默念几句咒语，那鬼便暂时被她收进了符纸中。
周奶奶看不懂林熙在做什么，可现在林熙无论做什么在她眼里都蒙上了一股神秘厉害的色彩。
想到林熙说的话，她当下便拍板道：“大师，给我孙子用那个符吧！”
林熙点头，下一秒便从裤兜里掏出提前在店里画好的安神符。
早在来这里之前的半个小时里，她便提前备好了可能用到的符，事实证明提早准备是明确的。
吴妈妈这会也开始犹豫了。
实在是刚刚林熙使的那几招太超出她以往的认知了，而儿子这段时间脾气有多不好她也看在眼里。
要让儿子配合她呆坐在原地不动，那是绝对不可能的事情。
所以，那就是林熙说的什么定身符是真的？
既然如此，儿子体内的鬼魂被赶出来也是真的咯？
所以此刻听到婆婆这么说，吴妈妈也罕见的没有开口阻止。
眼看林熙又掏出一张符，她本来以为是要像电视里那样烧了兑水给他喝，可林熙直接挥动着那张符在吴斌面前晃了两下，接着那符纸竟然无火自燃，火焰萦绕在林熙指尖，却没有伤到她分毫！
第17章在找被你带回来的鬼吗
一直到符纸燃尽，儿子缓缓睁开了眼。
content_en:
Chapter 17 Are you looking for the ghost you brought back?
The indoor doors and windows were closed, no wind was blowing in, and the air conditioner was always on so that the constant temperature would not change easily. Therefore, the sudden drop in temperature could mean that something had really been caused.
Thinking of this, Mother Wu's expression changed instantly.
Grandma Zhou is the only one who is so excited. Is this what it feels like to see a ghost? Although ghosts are a bit scary, isn't Lin Xi here? You must not be afraid!
Grandma Zhou is now a loyal fan of Lin Xi.
"Master, has that thing been captured? Where is it?"
Lin Xi had never seen such a courageous old lady, and she was so excited after seeing a ghost for the first time.
But the old lady is just an ordinary person. She has no yin and yang eyes and has a stable horoscope, so it is not easy to see these things.
"Just three steps away from you, due north."
Lin Xi kindly reminded the old lady of the ghost's location and asked her, "Do you want to see it? I can..."
help you.
Before she finished speaking, Grandma Zhou waved her hands crazily.
"No, no, I'm just curious, ha, ha, ha."
No matter how brave she is, she doesn't want to see a ghost.
Lin Xi and Grandma Zhou were chatting back and forth, but the ghost next to them was about to cry.
He never thought that one day he would make a mistake and fall directly into the hands of a little girl.
At this moment, she was holding him gently with one hand, and he was as defenseless as a little chicken, and he could vaguely feel a strong suppressive force.
But this girl obviously has no use for any treasures or utensils, only one pair of hands. Why is this? !
If Lin Xi knew what this ghost was curious about, she would probably tell him that although she did not use a treasure weapon, her soul had a strong suppression power against ghosts, ghosts and other things.
That is to say, the soul and the body have not yet been fully integrated, and she cannot exert one-tenth of her former power, but even so, the suppressive power of the soul can make them afraid.
The ghost was controlled by Lin Xi, but Wu Bin on the sofa suddenly closed his eyes.
When Wu's mother saw this, she immediately shouted: "Son? What's wrong with you, son?!"
Lin Xi glanced at him: "It's nothing serious. It's just that he is tired and weak due to the ghosts that have taken hold of him during this period. After a few days of sunshine, or I can give him a calming charm, it will be fine."
With that said, Lin Xi took off the holding talisman from Wu Bin's head with her other hand, folded it into a triangle, and silently recited a few spells, and the ghost was temporarily contained in the talisman paper.
Grandma Zhou couldn't understand what Lin Xi was doing, but now no matter what Lin Xi did, she had a mysterious and powerful color in her eyes.
Thinking of what Lin Xi said, she immediately said: "Master, use that talisman for my grandson!"
Lin Xi nodded, and the next second he took out the calming charm that he had drawn in the store in advance from his trouser pocket.
As early as half an hour before coming here, she had prepared the talismans that she might use. Facts have proved that it is clear to prepare in advance.
Mother Wu also began to hesitate at this moment.
It was true that the moves Lin Xi used just now were beyond her previous knowledge, and she could see how bad her son's temper was during this period.
It was absolutely impossible for her son to cooperate with her and sit still.
So, is the amulet Lin Xi said true?
In this case, is it true that the ghost in the son's body was driven out?
So when her mother-in-law said this, Mother Wu rarely spoke up to stop her.
When Lin Xi took out another talisman, she originally thought she was going to boil it and mix it with water for him to drink like on TV, but Lin Xi waved the talisman twice in front of Wu Bin, and then the talisman spontaneously ignited without fire. The flame lingered on Lin Xi's fingertips, but it did not hurt her at all!
Chapter 17 Are you looking for the ghost you brought back?
Until the talisman burned out, the son slowly opened his eyes.
